第四章风城往事（四）
待酒席结束，已经临近子时。
“大家吃好喝好玩好，就当是给我苏鸿章一个面子，不要客气。”苏鸿章喝醉了躺在何倩的怀里说着醉话。
“各位见笑了，老夫这就把他带回去。”苏磊赔笑着，把苏鸿章拉过来，随后带着苏家众人返回苏家。
“史长老，城主，我今天也喝多了点，就不陪二位了，告辞。”刘纪眉头紧皱，忍着醉意，拱了拱手，向台阶下走去。
“哎呀！”
刘纪脚步摇晃，一脚踩空，向地面倒去。
“爹！”刘昀和杨茜急速跑上前扶住刘纪。
“爹，你没事吧。”杨茜关心道。
不料刘纪眉头一皱，一把推开杨茜。
“滚，我没你这个儿媳妇。”刘纪说完又推开刘昀。
“老子还没成一把骨头，不用你扶！”刘纪晃晃悠悠的走下台阶，谁曾想下一秒便俩眼一闭，醉倒在地上。
“爹！”这一回只有刘昀跑上前及时扶住了正在下落的刘纪。
“史长老，李城主，我先带我爹回去了，今日多谢史长老款待，他日我们再来拜访。”刘昀说完，带着妻儿和刘纪向刘家走去。
“李城主，与我到摘星楼我的房间中在喝俩杯如何。”史长老邀请道。
“史长老，下次吧，我府中还有事，今日也是托您的光，我才得以忙里偷闲，现在我要是再不回去，府里可就乱套了。”李华无奈的摇了摇头道。
“既然城主有事，那老夫也不便叨扰，李城主慢走。”史长老道。
“史长老，告辞。”李华拱了拱手，离去。
咻！
史长老目送众人离开后，整理了一下自己的衣衫，刚抬起脚准备离开，突然，一支箭矢如闪电般疾驰着向他射来。

“谁！”
史长老失声惊叫，一个闪身敏捷地躲开。那支箭“嗖”的一声射在地上，箭头还插着一封信。
“鬼鬼祟祟，敢不敢出来一见。”史长老环顾四周，不见任何人的踪影。
此时已是子时，街上一个人都没有，史长老小心翼翼的拔出箭，取下那封信。
史长老再次看了看四周，随后将信放在玄戒中，向摘星楼走去。
苏家。
轰！
苏磊把苏鸿章一把扔在床上。
“平常就属他最不能喝，今日却好似发了疯，非要和刘伯伯拼酒，这么大的人了，还不让人放心。”何倩端着一盆水从外面走进来。
“少卿和桃儿都安顿好了吧。”苏磊道。
“安顿好了，少卿正在哄桃儿睡觉呢。”何倩一边擦拭着苏鸿章的身子一边说道。
“那就好。”苏磊在桌前坐下。
“爹，您先睡吧，这有我呢。”何倩道。
“呵呵，鸿章，别装了。”苏磊突然笑道。
何倩疑惑的看着满脸通红的苏鸿章。
“嘿嘿，爹，我的演技怎么样。”苏鸿章睁开眼笑着看向苏磊，那通红的脸渐渐恢复正常。
“这……？”何倩有些迷茫。
“酒楼中的酒壶我提前换过了，给鸿章倒的是水，给老刘倒的是烈酒。”苏磊笑道。
“啊？爹，为什么这么做。”何倩不解道。
“刘伯伯和弟妹不和，爹想趁着他醉倒的机会，让弟妹和子奇好好照顾一下他，看能不能有所好转。”苏鸿章道：“这件事，爹和我还有刘昀已经提前商量过了，他知道该怎么做。”

何倩沉思了一会道：“爹，恕我直言，这恐怕，无济于事。”
“死马当活马医吧，这么多年了，关系不能一直僵着吧。”苏磊叹道。

Chapter 4 Past Events in the Windy City (4)
By the time the banquet was over, it was already approaching midnight.
"Everyone eat well, drink and have fun, just think of it as a favor to me, Su Hongzhang, you're welcome." Su Hongzhang was drunk and lying in He Qian's arms, talking drunkenly.
"Everyone is laughing, I will take him back now." Su Lei smiled apologetically, pulled Su Hongzhang over, and then returned to the Su family with everyone in the Su family.
"Elder Shi, City Lord, I drank a little too much today, so I won't accompany you two. I'll say goodbye." Liu Ji frowned, endured his drunkenness, cupped his hands, and walked down the steps.
"Ouch!"
Liu Ji staggered, stepped on the air, and fell to the ground.
"Dad!" Liu Yun and Yang Qian quickly ran forward to support Liu Ji.
"Dad, are you okay?" Yang Qian asked with concern.
Unexpectedly, Liu Ji frowned and pushed Yang Qian away.
"Go away, I don't have a daughter-in-law like you." Liu Ji said and pushed Liu Yun away.
"I'm not a bone yet, I don't need your support!" Liu Ji staggered down the steps. Who would have thought that the next second he would close his eyes and fall drunk on the ground.
"Dad!" This time only Liu Yun ran forward and helped the falling Liu Ji in time.
"Elder Shi, City Lord Li, I am taking my father back first. Thank you Elder Shi for your hospitality today. We will visit again tomorrow." After Liu Yun finished speaking, he took his wife, children and Liu Ji to the Liu family.
"City Lord Li, how about you come with me to my room in Zhaixing Building and have a drink?" Elder Shi invited.
"Elder Shi, let's do it next time. I still have something to do in my house. It's thanks to you that I was able to take a break today. If I don't go back now, the house will be in chaos." Li Hua shook his head helplessly.
"Since the city lord has something to do, I won't bother you. City lord Li will go slowly." Elder Shi said.
"Elder Shi, farewell." Li Hua cupped his hands and left.
call out!
After Elder Shi watched everyone leave, he straightened his clothes and just raised his feet to leave. Suddenly, an arrow flew towards him like lightning.
"Who!"
Elder Shi screamed and dodged quickly. The arrow hit the ground with a "whoosh" sound, and there was a letter stuck in the arrow.
"Sneaky, do you dare to come out and see me?" Elder Shi looked around, but there was no sign of anyone.
It was already midnight and there was no one on the street. Elder Shi carefully pulled out the arrow and took down the letter.
Elder Shi looked around again, then put the letter in the Xuan Ring and walked towards the Star-Zhaing Tower.
Su family.
boom!
Su Lei threw Su Hongzhang on the bed.
"Normally he is the one who can't drink the most, but today he seems to have gone crazy. He insists on drinking with Uncle Liu. He is not reassuring for such an old man." He Qian came in from outside with a basin of water.
"Shaoqing and Tao'er have settled down," Su Lei said.
"It's settled, Shaoqing is putting Tao'er to sleep." He Qian said while wiping Su Hongzhang's body.
"That's good." Su Lei sat down at the table.
"Dad, you go to bed first, I'm here." He Qian said.
"Haha, Hongzhang, stop pretending." Su Lei suddenly laughed.
He Qian looked at Su Hongzhang who was flushed with confusion.
"Hey, dad, how are my acting skills?" Su Hongzhang opened his eyes and looked at Su Lei with a smile, and his red face gradually returned to normal.
"This...?" He Qian was a little confused.
"I changed the wine bottles in the restaurant in advance. I poured water for Hong Zhang and strong liquor for Lao Liu." Su Lei said with a smile.
"Ah? Dad, why do you do this?" He Qian asked confused.
"Uncle Liu is at odds with his younger siblings. Dad wants to take advantage of his drunkenness to ask his younger siblings and Zi Qi to take good care of him to see if things can get better." Su Hongzhang said, "Dad, I and Liu Yun have already discussed this matter in advance, and he knows what to do."
He Qian pondered for a while and said, "Dad, with all due respect, I'm afraid this won't help."
"Let's treat a dead horse as a living doctor. After so many years, the relationship cannot beJust stay frozen. "Su Lei sighed.
